name: IdleDown30
prompt:
Production 2D top-down RPG SPRITE SHEET. Use the attached approved hero strictly as character-design reference: same face and dark hair, same detailed black plate/leather armor and gold fasteners, same burgundy cape, same sword/sheath ALWAYS on the same anatomical hip (viewer RIGHT in frontal view). Detailed dark-fantasy PIXEL ART with deliberate crisp pixel clusters, muted palette, not a painting or 3D render. Front/down view in EVERY frame, fixed camera and scale. Output EXACTLY THIRTY full-body sprites arranged in FIVE columns and SIX rows in row-major temporal order. Large portrait sheet, ideally 1920 by 3072, empty transparent gutters between cells. Each cell identical canvas, head centered and ground baseline fixed. Real transparency, no background, ground shadow, text, numbers, grid or borders. No cropped cape/hair/weapon. Never mirror rows; preserve clothing asymmetries and same sword hip. Every sprite must be a separately drawn chronological phase, not arbitrary design variations. Body height and anatomical proportions constant. Last pose connects smoothly to first, but do not duplicate first as frame29.
Animation: IDLE_Down, thirty successive drawings spanning ONE calm breathing period. Legs and BOTH boots planted in exactly the SAME stable stance and screen coordinates throughout ALL thirty cells: no walking, stepping, bouncing or alternating knees. Start with a relaxed neutral exhale. Frames0..7: gently increasing inhalation in chest/shoulders by tiny amounts;8..14 slowly reach the inhale peak;15..22 ease into exhale;23..29 return toward initial relaxed exhale. Stable head/face/hips; subtle sleeve/hand relaxation. Cape hem and a few hair strands follow a smooth tiny delayed breeze, maintaining their shape. Animate breathing with real changed armor articulation, not shifting/scaling the entire static body. Quiet restrained changes, coherent matching facial identity, no morphing plates or random posing. All30 phases distinct and temporally coherent. Feet never move.

Both legs must pass through the intermediate airborne poses; no thirty front portraits with just changing cape. Natural moderate stride, stable identity/scale, seamless last→first. No duplicated phases, speed lines or synthetic interpolation.
